content.title: Bosch Rexroth M8x30-Grade 8 Hex Bolt, M8x1.25 Thread, 30mm Length, Alloy Steel, SAE J429 Grade 8
content.short_description: M8x30 hex bolt in alloy steel, SAE J429 Grade 8, with M8x1.25 thread pitch and 1034 MPa tensile strength. Hex drive for standard wrench or socket installation.
content.long_description:
Bosch Rexroth M8x30-Grade 8 is a hex head bolt manufactured to SAE J429 Grade 8 specification, constructed from alloy steel. The fastener carries an M8 thread size with a 1.25 mm thread pitch and an overall length of 30 mm.

Grade 8 classification corresponds to a minimum tensile strength of 1034 MPa, suitable for applications requiring high clamp load and fatigue resistance in comparison to lower property class fasteners. The hex drive head allows installation and removal with standard hex wrenches or sockets.

Confirm thread engagement depth, mating nut or tapped hole grade, and torque specifications against SAE J429 Grade 8 requirements before installation. Verify M8x1.25 thread compatibility with the mating component prior to procurement.
